steps.title: Open the project and click "Export Website" at the top
steps.body: button above the list on the project page. There are two methods in the menu: **Offline website · Packaged component**, the component is packaged with the website, and does not depend on other URLs after deployment. In most cases, choose it; **Online website · Reference publishing component**, the custom component is loaded from the published fixed version URL, and readers need to be connected to the Internet.

steps.title: Choose an output directory
steps.body: Exported are all unarchived pages in the project. Select an empty directory; you can also select a website directory that was previously exported for the same project, and its list will be updated and pages that no longer exist will be deleted. Other non-empty directories are rejected.
steps.result: It prompts "The website has been exported and can be deployed to static hosting."

steps.title: Deploy or local preview
steps.body: Upload the entire directory to any static hosting. When viewing locally, use an HTTP service to open the directory, do not double-click the file directly - the pages of the website share the reader under `assets/`.

content.text: What can readers do after opening it?

Readers do not need to install ShowAI. The exported webpage retains Page reading, Board browsing and layer-by-layer expansion; chart tips, collapsed content, maps, flowcharts and local calculations in components can continue to be used.

content.text: Publish components to allow web pages to be loaded online

The default package export is the most worry-free. Publish is only needed if you want multiple web pages to share the same published component and make the file size smaller. Publishing is a link that you control: ShowAI prepares the files and verifies them, and uploading is done by you.

props.title: From preparation to publication to reader opening

steps.label: Ready for release
steps.detail: `publish prepare `(or MCP `publication_prepare `) generates `manifest.json `, description metadata, and `bundle.json `with complete dependencies, file path and SHA-256 digest of the contents. This step only writes local files.

steps.label: Upload release directory
steps.detail: Upload to a static hosting of your own choice. ShowAI won't upload it for you. Readers' browsers need to be able to read these files across domains.

steps.label: Verify with URL
steps.detail: `publish verify --url MANIFEST_URL `. MCP connections that only bind a single project cannot be registered for publication and need to be completed using the CLI.

steps.label: Check item by item
steps.detail: Check byte counts, transfer digests, packet fingerprints, and dependency integrity. **After all passes** install to "Published" and save the URL verification record. The transfer budget is 512 MiB per checksum, with a maximum of 256 MiB for a single release package.

steps.label: Reference published component export
steps.detail: Only accurate versions with local verification records will be accepted and will not be quietly replaced with newer versions.

steps.label: Open the web page and download the component
steps.detail: The page displays "Verifying and loading published fixed version components...".

steps.label: Displayed after passing the verification
steps.detail: If SHA-256 or the number of bytes is inconsistent, it will refuse to load and explain which component it is; if there is a problem with the network or cross-domain settings, it will prompt you to check the network and CORS. Integrity verification requires HTTPS or opening the page locally.
